rubric.beginner: One inverse operation; judge signed arithmetic separately.
rubric.intermediate: Two inverse operations with variable on one side; constant denominators provisionally permitted.
rubric.advanced: Variables on both sides, multi-step bracket/denominator reasoning or at least three inverse operations.
rubric.borderline_decision: Two original simple multiplicative-bracket questions are provisionally Advanced despite a two-operation shortcut; teacher may choose Intermediate. Grouped numerator divided by a constant is provisionally Intermediate.

content_hash_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, compact comma/colon separators
content_hash_contract.question_scope: All question fields except content_hash, approved_difficulty, teacher_review. Proposed difficulty and rubric version ARE hashed.
content_hash_contract.approval_policy: Separate actual teacher attestation tied to exact content hash and rubric. Approved difficulty must match proposal; otherwise create a new revision. Never overwrite this draft as an approved release.
content_hash_contract.limitation: Traceability/tamper detection only; not signatures or enforced filesystem immutability.

assessment_contract.hangman_scored_unit: One final-value question; internal operation steps are not extra Hangman answers
assessment_contract.release_gate: Actual teacher/rubric approval and hashes; 30 selected revisions, 10 approved per tier; both-mode/language verification; compatible recovery/export; database inventory before shared-DB publication. Not implemented here.
